Results.ReviewText: After years of supermarket and off brand charcoal grills, several years ago I bought the Deluxe 22" kettle.  I should have bought one years ago.  These things are built to last forever, replacement grates and all other parts are easy to find and don't change year to year, and I grill, roast, and smoke on mine.  I can make better beef brisket than any BBQ joint around me, and smoking a whole turkey for the holidays is a breeze.  With the vents and thermometer, it's idiot-proof to use (I should know !), and the ash-can in the bottom makes clean-up a breeze.  I've rarely been this satisfied with a purchase as I have this Weber.
Results.Title: A Classic Design that just Works !

Results.ReviewText: Had a 22in Weber kettles with open ash catcher below for 30 years. Cook's approximately the same except a little more even because of the ash catcher attached to the bottom of the grill distributes air more evenly into the bottom vent. I like the  air vent shut off it closes at the far left position stop which makes for a positive shut off no guessing. It saves the charcoal from burning away. The thermometer lets you know what the temperature is inside which makes it easier to cook.
Results.Title: Old Weber with extras.

Results.ReviewText:
It's an amazing grill that has made grilling fun again and with the app I've tried making meals i would have stayed away from.
on top of all that its a great looking grill I purchased the copper colored grill and have named it Sputnik since it resembles the satellite. Truly a great addition very I am happy with my purchase.
Results.Title: Old School Grilling

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for grilling ,smoking and making pizza.  Small enough to store easily and yet big enough to smoke 3 full rib racks in half.
Results.Title: Great grill.

Results.ReviewText: Assembled it in 10 minutes! Plenty of space for grilling or smoking. Easy ash removal and great paint finish. Would give as a gift.
Results.Title: It's perfect.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill for smoking or just slapping on some burgers. Assembly was a piece of cake
Results.Title: Love it for charcoal and wood cooking

Results.ReviewText: Very versatile and great for beginners to experts. I’ve grilled, smoked, and seared my way to some fantastic meals for my family.
Results.Title: Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Grill works well. Lid does not fit the best and easily slides off.
Results.Title: Works fine but lid is not secure

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, easy to clean, easy to use had Weber propane grill but switched to charcoal.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22"

Results.ReviewText: My wife and I are truly enjoying this grill. My wife got me this as a birthday gift this past August and it is so easy to use, I have made so much food on it. She is definitely enjoying the amazing food and not to mention the less time spent in the kitchen!
Results.Title: I'm a grilling machine!

Results.ReviewText: Cooks great, super easy clean up. Easily controlled
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: Sufficient for occasional use, compact for a small space, made well, easy to assemble and use. Great grill for people who are not sure how much they will like a grill, are new to grilling, or need one occasionally. I love loading the charcoal and relaxing with a beverage and book or chatting with friends waiting for it to heat up. But there are ways to speed up that process too.
Results.Title: Perfect starter grill, won't disappoint

Results.ReviewText: Very good grill - large cooking space, even heat.  Helpful features.  Very dependable no frills charcoal grill
Results.Title: Very Good Grill

Results.ReviewText: Grill was sent with a cover for for your cheapest grill so I couldn't install the thermometer.  Emailed Customer Service & provided pics and a new and better cover was sent to me ASAP so far I'm happy with this grill.
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22"

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I've ever owned. Cooks so evenly. Love it!
Results.Title: Best grill ever!

Results.ReviewText: Besides the expectational performance, quality and craftsmanship you can expect from a Webber I didn’t know that Webber offered color options .  I purchased the copper color and very happy with the color choice.  In addition,  their customers service is 5 stars.
Results.Title: Color options!

Results.ReviewText: Very nice grill. Large surface for lots of food.  Would like it to stand taller, but that's just a tall person problem.  Incredible control of heat.  Surprisingly a great indirect heat device.  Holds temps and will allow the unburned coals to go out for use next time.  The ash catch is fantastic.  It keeps my dogs out of the ashes and very clean to dump.  I'm surprised at what I can do with this grill.
Results.Title: Everything I expected in a grill.

Results.ReviewText: My last kettle rusted out. So I bought another one exactly like it.
Results.Title: Second one

Results.ReviewText:
Not sure if it’s my Webber or the design, but the ash pot on the bottom doesn’t slide and lock like it should. I’m always fighting it (and not always winning) to stay on or get off! 
Other than that it’s working awesome.
Results.Title: 1 star away from perfect.

Results.ReviewText: Gold standard of grills. Very versatile. I own five including the Q1200.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText:
Excellent product, tasty barbecued chicken.
Now I have 3 Weber grills.
Results.Title: Kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: The 22” kettle is great for everyday grilling. Whether you you direct, indirect, or even low N slow, the kettle will do it all. If I could only have one grill within this price range, then it’d be a Weber kettle. Really impressed on its versatility.
Results.Title: Best Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Super grill so far, ribs,Cornish hen,wings,Cajun links,tenderloin,fish and veggies so far thumbs up
Results.Title: Weber original grill

Results.ReviewText: This has proven to be a much better grill that the one I had previously, especially for smoking meats. Looking forward to cooking some  good meals on this baby !!!
Results.Title: Better than my last grill

Results.ReviewText: Old faithful is better in Premium. The ash is so much easier to clean up. This is a must have for any serious griller.
Results.Title: Fantastic

Results.ReviewText: Amazing, and easy to use charcoal.  I have only use gaz BBQ until now, and I am still a novice.  The greatest benefit of the Webber Kettle is its popularity, which make the amount of Youtube videos available is incredible. I had a little problem with the main grate, and customer supporft replaced the part very rapidly.
Results.Title: Amazing BBQing equipment

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are so sorry to hear about the disappointment you experienced with the lid seal. As the grill is used, it will season the lid and create a tighter seal. Rest assured, we are here to help. Please be on the lookout for a follow-up email from us shortly. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The lid does not fit well on the kettle and the material is a much small gauge than the old Weber Kettles I fell in love with.
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText: Great grill and great results with cooking outcomes and taste.  Something to be said for the experience grilling with a charcoal grill.  My only complaint is the grill lid thermometer as I don't think it is very accurate.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love the Weber kettle grill. Was using a gas grill and just didn't enjoy the flavor of my food as much as I do with the charcoal grill.
Results.Title: One Happy Old Lady

Results.ReviewText: Excellent and well made product.  We are really impressed with the quality.  Money very well spent.
Results.Title: Great Quality and Value

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grilled foods with steaks, chops, chicken and fish. Easy to setup and cleans with little effort.
Results.Title: Grill that Will

Results.ReviewText: I won’t ever go back to propane. The flavor and diverse things you can do with this grill will astound you. Grill, high heat sear, smoke, slow cook. Get the right accessories and you can even fry or use a wok. Just incredible.
Results.Title: Best of both worlds

Results.ReviewText: Plenty of room for anything I need to grill. Grates and grill are made of excellent materials. I have no complaints.
Results.Title: Loving my 22”kettle premium

Results.ReviewText: My third Weber 22" grill in 50 years. Yes, when taken care of they really do last !!
Results.Title: Longevity of a Weger grill

Results.ReviewText: Just what I wanted and as great as I thought it would be.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Works as expected. This is my third Weber. Got my first when I was 18. I’m 70 now.
Results.Title: Expectations and I’m a long time owner.

Results.ReviewText: wanted one for a long time, but kept buying knock offs, probably spending twice as much overall. Very happy I finally made the purchase! Thick metal construction, excellent air control and ash management. Great product with lots of accessories availible
Results.Title: great product

Results.ReviewText: It is an okay grill for the price, the metal since to be poor quality but I will see how long it last.  I love grilling and have used it several times already, it keeps the heat well and food comes out good.
Results.Title: It is an okay grill

Results.ReviewText: I've had 2 of the weber 22" charcoal grills. I love them. I just don't do gas grills. They don't do what I want them to do, and the whole process isn't what I'm after. Nothing like charcoal or chunk grilling. I recently.mpved and my.old grill stayed behind. I got a new one right away at my new place.
Results.Title: Great grill.

Results.ReviewText: This is the second time I've ever had to buy a Weber Kettle Grill in the past 15 years.  These are made to last and are extremely durable.  I bought this 22.5-inch copper-colored kettle after 15 years of consistent use with my old one.  I love the subtle updates after 15 years, all of which help perfect the art of smoking and charcoal cooking.  And wow, this copper color sure is beautiful!  After assembly, I ran into a bit of an issue with my paint, but the company immediately jumped to fix the problem.  Weber is the best in the business and there are no other substitutes.
Results.Title: Best In The Business

Results.ReviewText: The Kettle is an icon of backyard grills. As always Weber’s unbeatable attention to quality shines through in this 2021 grill. I own 3 Weber brand grills gas, pellet and of course the charcoal Kettle. No issues, easy assembly. Must have for beginners and grill masters.
Results.Title: Never better. Icon of charcoal grills

Results.ReviewText: Love it! The grill is easy to use, easy to control the heat.
Results.Title: Great grill.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Love the thermostat and the ash catcher-no mess and easy to cook a variety of foods from steak to brownies.
Results.Title: Love this grill!

Results.ReviewText: It’s a spacious, versatile, well manufactured and good looking grill! You know, like all Webers! But what makes a Weber grill retain its customers over decades is service. No one, in any industry matches the kind of customer service Weber provides. My wife bought me this grill for Father’s Day this year but my smaller Weber worked fine. I decided to save putting it together until a couple of weeks ago as we planned to host a pool party the following weekend. Turns out I lost one of the side legs. I emailed support for replacement which they immediately responded and helped me order the correct kit. It arrived faster than I expected. My family and friends loved the food and was the focus of conversation while a few of us were standing around my grill as it cooked. That’s Weber! That's the customer service that's kept me from straying to a different brand since my first Weber purchase back in 2005.
ordered online, free and fast delivery, easy to assemble cooks great.
Results.Title: every mans dream

Results.ReviewText: Perfecting the art of slow cooking on the kettle, this thing puts out some delicious meat.
Results.Title: Just buy it, you'll thank yourself later.

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
